text: A summary of my pastoral ministry experience My educational qualiﬁcations are the following: San Jose, State University in 1997 with a BA in Comparative Religious Studies. University of Phoenix with an MBA in non-proﬁt management in 2004. Newburgh Theological Seminary with a MA in Biblical Studies in 2007. Newburgh Theological Seminary with a Doctorate in Biblical Studies in 2010. I became a full time, paid pastor of Cornerstone Fellowship, San Lorenzo, CA, in 2005. I was the only person on staﬀ. I organized and taught adult Bible studies, i organized Bile study, potlucks, i provided counseling and guidance for people in the church, mostly widows, and i ran the Sunday morning service designing the liturgy and preaching the sermons. I performed weddings and funerals as needed for members of the congregation. I was also the front line representative of the church when the county and state came against churches. i was given the opportunity to witness to county employees and representatives many times from 2018 to 2021. Since February 2024, my primary focus of pastoral ministry is Kingsway Foursquare in Sequim, WA. I am a licensed pastor of adult discipleship. Currently I am teaching a foundational adult Bible study on Wednesday nights. I am also part of the pastoral care team. I take part in visitation to hospitals and homes, i meet with people to listen and give advice. I perform funerals as needed. I am an active member oﬀ the pastoral team at Kingsway, which is my primary focus of serving God. Should I be endorsed and accepted as an Auxiliary Chaplain for the USCG, my volunteer commitment will be approximately one day a month or as needed.
